title: suderra.edge-provisioning-request.v1 query parameters
description: Query parameters of GET /install/{device_code}/suderra-os, as a JSON object of strings (delivery.json network.request, ADR-048 DEC-5.5). The root provision worker builds them from the device's own records; the provisioning token travels only in the X-Provisioning-Token header. The cloud binds the binding and the nonce into the manifest and uses board_profile, os_version and agent_abi to choose a release the device can run; the device still enforces every check itself (DEC-8.2, DEC-23).

nonce.description: Fresh per request from the root worker's CSPRNG, 128 to 512 bits in lowercase hex; the manifest must echo it.

board_profile.description: board_profile from /etc/suderra/board of the signed image.
